# Herzog--Schönheim 1974 bibliographic record

Audit date: 2026-08-03 JST (UTC+09:00)

M. Herzog and J. Schönheim, *Research problem no. 9*, Canadian Mathematical
Bulletin 17 (1974), 150.

The original item is the source of the conjecture. The bibliographic data and
statement were cross-checked against the reference and introduction in:

L. Margolis and O. Schnabel, *The Herzog--Schönheim Conjecture for Small
Groups and Harmonic Subgroups*, arXiv:1803.03569, especially the introduction
and reference `[HS74]`.

https://arxiv.org/pdf/1803.03569

No publication time or time zone is asserted for the 1974 item.
